texts.zh:
随着[fromfrom.solar_system.GetName]中的战斗进入尾声，一份来自客服无人机的新信息显示到了我们的屏幕上。

“我们留意到您对我方最终用户许可协议强制执行抗拒。由于您展现出压倒性军事力量，我们现正式废除对MKIII地质辐射矩阵的知识产权声索。我们希望您能在使用这一新科技的过程中获得快乐。”

无人机发生了爆炸，同时切断了通讯链接。
texts.en:
As the battle draws to a close in [fromfrom.solar_system.GetName], a new communication from the customer service drone plays on our screens.

"We have noted your objection to our efforts to enforce the terms of the End User License Agreement. As a result of your display of overwhelming military might, we will now rescind our claim to the intellectual property of the MKIII Georadiation Matrix. We hope you enjoy your newly acquired technology."

The drone explodes, severing the communication link.

texts.zh: 处理掉了客服无人机后，我们现在就可以继续逆向工程这台地质辐射矩阵了。
texts.en: With the customer service drones dealt with, we are now able to resume retro-engineering the Georadiation Matrix.

texts.zh: 通过分析[planet.GetName]上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
texts.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on [planet.GetName], we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.

texts.zh: 通过孜孜不倦的企业家级效率，我们重新设计了MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进操作方法来产生最大的利润。
texts.en: Through relentless entrepreneurial efficiency, we have retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, refining its operational methods to yield maximum profit.

texts.zh: 通过深入的研究工作，我们得以重新设计MKIII地质辐射矩阵，通过改进流程解锁了其全部的潜力。
texts.en: After extensive study, we have successfully retro-engineered the MKIII Georadiation Matrix, unlocking its potential with added improvements to the process.

texts.zh: 通过将放射性分子去稳技术整合进环境改造设备，现在我们可以刺激高价值资源的生长了。
texts.en: By integrating radioactive molecular destabilization into our terraforming equipment, we can stimulate the growth of valuable resources.
